<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Rhine Gorge Castles — Koblenz to Bingen</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.css" />
<style>
:root{
--bg:#0f1620; --card:#182233; --card2:#1e2b40; --accent:#c9a24b; --accent2:#7fb3d5;
--text:#eef2f6; --muted:#9fb0c3; --border:#2a3a52; --done:#3a5a40;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
body{
margin:0; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); padding-bottom:70px;
}
header{
padding:16px 16px 10px; position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--bg); z-index:10;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
h1{font-size:1.15rem; margin:0 0 2px; color:var(--accent);}
.sub{color:var(--muted); font-size:0.82rem; margin:0;}
.search{
width:100%; margin-top:10px; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:10px;
border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--card); color:var(--text); font-size:0.95rem;
}
.lang-switch{display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:8px;}
.lang-btn{
flex:1; padding:8px; border-radius:9px; border:1px solid var(--border);
background:var(--card); color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; font-size:.82rem; cursor:pointer;
}
.lang-btn.active{background:#008cff; border-color:#008cff; color:#fff;}
.gps-control-bar{
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px;
margin-top:8px; padding:6px 10px; background:var(--card2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px;
font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--muted);
}
.gps-toggle-btn{
background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--text);
padding:5px 10px; border-radius:7px; font-weight:700; font-size:0.75rem; cursor:pointer;
}
.gps-toggle-btn.gps-active{background:#2e7d32; border-color:#2e7d32; color:#fff;}
.gps-found-banner{
display:none; background:#0d3a24; border:1px solid #1e8a54; color:#bdf5d3;
border-radius:10px; padding:8px 12px; font-size:.82rem; margin:8px 0 0;
text-align:center; font-weight:600;
}
.gps-found-banner.show{display:block;}
#textSizeControl{
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
margin:8px auto 4px; max-width:220px;
}
#textSizeControl button{
min-width:42px; min-height:38px; padding:5px 10px;
border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:9px;
background:var(--card); color:var(--text);
font-size:18px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;
}
#textSizeValue{min-width:54px; text-align:center; color:var(--muted); font-size:14px;}
body.lang-ru .lang-en{display:none;}
body.lang-en .lang-ru{display:none;}
.stat-table{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:8px; font-size:0.85rem;}
.stat-table th{text-align:left; color:var(--accent); font-size:0.72rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.03em; padding:4px 6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.stat-table td{padding:5px 6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--text);}
.stat-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
.tabs{
display:flex; gap:6px; padding:10px 12px; overflow-x:auto;
position:sticky; top:115px; background:var(--bg); z-index:99;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.tab{
flex:0 0 auto; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:20px; background:var(--card);
border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--muted); font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer;
white-space:nowrap;
}
.tab.active{background:var(--accent); color:#1a1406; border-color:var(--accent); font-weight:600;}
main{padding:10px 12px 20px;}
.view{display:none;}
.view.active{display:block;}
.route-card{
background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px;
padding:14px 15px; margin-bottom:10px;
}
.route-kicker{font-size:.68rem; letter-spacing:.12em; color:#008cff; font-weight:800; margin-bottom:4px;}
.route-card h3{margin:0 0 4px; color:var(--text); font-size:1.05rem;}
.route-place{color:var(--accent2); font-size:.8rem; margin-bottom:9px;}
.route-card p{margin:0 0 8px; line-height:1.52; font-size:.9rem;}
.route-card p:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
.route-hook{background:#102238; border-left:3px solid #008cff; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:7px; margin-top:9px; font-style:italic;}
.route-source-note{font-size:.72rem !important; color:var(--muted); margin-top:10px !important;}
.route-open-btn{
width:100%; margin-top:8px; min-height:48px; border-radius:11px; border:1px solid #008cff;
background:#008cff; color:#fff; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer;
}
.route-open-btn:active{transform:scale(.99);}
.castle-card{
background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px;
padding:12px 14px; margin-bottom:10px; transition:opacity .2s;
}
.castle-card.done{opacity:0.45;}
.castle-top{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; cursor:pointer;}
.checkbox{
width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:6px; border:2px solid var(--accent2);
flex:0 0 22px; margin-top:2px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
font-size:0.8rem; color:transparent; cursor:pointer;
}
.castle-card.done .checkbox{background:var(--done); border-color:var(--done); color:#fff;}
.castle-name{font-weight:600; font-size:1rem; color:var(--text);}
.castle-town{color:var(--accent2); font-size:0.82rem;}
.castle-meta{display:flex; gap:14px; margin-top:6px; font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--muted); flex-wrap:wrap;}
.badge{
background:var(--card2); border-radius:6px; padding:2px 8px; font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--muted);
}
.expand-hint{margin-left:auto; color:var(--muted); font-size:1.1rem; transform:rotate(0deg); transition:transform .2s;}
.castle-card.open .expand-hint{transform:rotate(180deg);}
.detail{display:none; margin-top:12px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--border); font-size:0.88rem; line-height:1.5;}
.castle-card.open .detail{display:block;}
.detail h4{margin:10px 0 4px; color:var(--accent); font-size:0.82rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.03em;}
.detail h4:first-child{margin-top:0;}
.detail p{margin:0 0 8px; color:var(--text);}
.legend-box{
background:var(--card2); border-left:3px solid var(--accent); padding:8px 10px; border-radius:6px; margin-top:4px;
}
.say-line{
background:#101a26; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 10px; margin-top:6px; font-style:italic; color:#cfe0ee;
}
.info-card{
background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px; padding:14px; margin-bottom:12px;
}
.info-card h3{margin:0 0 6px; color:var(--accent); font-size:0.95rem;}
.info-card p{margin:0 0 8px; font-size:0.9rem; line-height:1.5;}
.progress{
position:fixed; bottom:0; left:0; right:0; background:var(--card);
border-top:1px solid var(--border); padding:10px 16px; display:flex;
justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--muted); z-index:100;
}
.progress b{color:var(--accent);}
.reset-btn{
background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--muted);
border-radius:8px; padding:5px 10px; font-size:0.78rem; cursor:pointer;
}
#mapDiv{
width:100%; height:62vh; min-height:390px; border-radius:14px;
overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--border); position:relative;
}
.leaflet-popup-content-wrapper{background:var(--card); color:var(--text); border-radius:10px;}
.leaflet-popup-tip{background:var(--card);}
.popup-title{font-weight:700; color:#008cff; margin-bottom:5px;}
.popup-line{font-size:.82rem; color:var(--muted); margin:3px 0; white-space:normal;}
.map-controls{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:8px;}
.map-nav-btn{
flex:1; min-height:44px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
background:var(--card); color:var(--text); font-weight:600; cursor:pointer;
}
.map-nav-btn:active{transform:scale(.98);}
.map-nav-btn.primary{background:#008cff; color:#fff; border-color:#008cff;}
.map-status{margin-top:6px; font-size:.76rem; color:var(--muted); text-align:center;}
.map-panel{
position:absolute; z-index:1200; left:12px; right:12px; bottom:12px;
background:rgba(24,34,51,.98); border:1px solid #008cff; border-radius:14px;
box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45); padding:14px;
max-height:68%; overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; touch-action:pan-y; overscroll-behavior:contain; display:none;
}
.map-panel.open{display:block;}
.map-panel-head{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px;}
.map-panel-title{font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; color:#008cff; flex:1;}
.map-panel-close{
width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid var(--border);
background:var(--card2); color:var(--text); font-size:1.15rem; cursor:pointer; flex:0 0 34px;
}
.map-panel-meta{font-size:.8rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px;}
.map-panel-section{
margin-top:10px; padding-top:9px; border-top:1px solid var(--border);
font-size:.88rem; line-height:1.48;
}
.map-panel-section strong{color:#008cff;}
.map-panel-legend{
padding:9px 10px; border-left:3px solid #008cff;
background:#102238; border-radius:7px;
}
.map-panel-say{
margin-top:8px; padding:9px 10px; background:#101a26; border-radius:8px;
font-style:italic; color:#d8e6f2; line-height:1.4;
}
.map-panel-speak{
position:sticky; bottom:0; z-index:5;
width:100%; margin-top:8px; min-height:48px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:9px;
border:1px solid #008cff; background:#008cff; color:#fff; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;
box-shadow:0 -6px 12px rgba(15,22,32,.85);
}
.map-panel-speak.speaking{background:#102238; color:#008cff;}
.castle-name-tooltip{
background:var(--card); color:var(--text); border:1px solid #008cff;
border-radius:8px; padding:5px 8px; font-weight:600;
box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.castle-name-tooltip:before{border-top-color:var(--card) !important;}
.map-note{font-size:.78rem; color:var(--muted); margin:8px 2px 0;}
.castle-halo{
animation: haloPulse 1.4s ease-out infinite;
pointer-events:none;
}
@keyframes haloPulse{
0% { r:14; opacity:.55; }
70% { r:26; opacity:0; }
100% { r:26; opacity:0; }
}
@media (min-width:800px){
.map-panel{
left:auto; width:min(390px,42%); right:14px; bottom:14px; max-height:72%;
}
}
@media (max-width:600px){
header{padding:10px 12px 8px;}
h1{font-size:1.02rem;}
.search{margin-top:7px; padding:9px 10px;}
.tabs{padding-bottom:7px;}
.tab{padding:7px 12px;}
main{padding-top:7px;}
#mapDiv{height:64vh; min-height:430px;}
.map-panel{left:8px; right:8px; bottom:8px; max-height:68%;}
.map-controls{gap:6px;}
.map-nav-btn{font-size:.82rem;}
}
.guide-card{
background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px;
padding:18px; max-width:760px; margin:0 auto;
}
.guide-kicker{font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.12em; color:#008cff; font-weight:700;}
.guide-counter{float:right; color:var(--muted); font-size:.78rem;}
.guide-card h2{font-size:1.45rem; margin:5px 0 3px; color:var(--text);}
.guide-meta{color:var(--muted); font-size:.86rem; margin-bottom:15px;}
.guide-block{margin-top:13px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--border); line-height:1.55; font-size:.94rem;}
.guide-label{font-size:.7rem; letter-spacing:.1em; font-weight:800; color:#008cff; margin-bottom:5px;}
.say-block{border:1px solid #008cff; border-radius:11px; padding:12px; background:#102238;}
.guide-say{font-size:1.03rem; line-height:1.5; font-style:italic;}
.speak-btn{margin-top:10px; min-height:42px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:9px; border:1px solid #008cff; background:#008cff; color:#fff; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;}
.speak-btn.speaking{background:#102238; color:#008cff;}
.speak-status{font-size:.72rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:5px; min-height:15px;}
.legend-guide-block{background:#102238; border-left:4px solid #008cff; padding:12px; border-radius:8px;}
.guide-more{margin-top:12px; color:var(--muted); font-size:.86rem;}
.guide-more summary{cursor:pointer; color:var(--text); font-weight:600; padding:7px 0;}
#guideDetails{padding-top:7px; line-height:1.5;}
.guide-actions{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:17px;}
.guide-actions button{
flex:1; min-height:48px; border-radius:11px; border:1px solid var(--border);
background:var(--card2); color:var(--text); font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;
}
.guide-actions button:first-child,.guide-actions button:last-child{
background:#008cff; border-color:#008cff; color:#fff;
}
@media (max-width:600px){
.guide-card{padding:15px;}
.guide-card h2{font-size:1.3rem;}
.guide-say{font-size:1rem;}
.guide-block{font-size:.9rem;}
.guide-actions button{min-height:50px; font-size:.78rem;}
}
</style>
</head>

<div class="lang-en">

</div>

<p style="margin-top:8px;">Площадь виноградников: около 2200 га в 1900 году → около 460 га сегодня. Большинство оставшихся хозяйств обрабатывают меньше 10 га.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="info-card">
<h3>UNESCO World Heritage</h3>
<p>Since 2002, the Upper Middle Rhine Valley (Koblenz to Bingen, ~65 km) is a UNESCO World Heritage Site — for the landscape as a whole: castles, vineyards, and small towns together, not any single building.</p>
</div>
<div class="info-card">
<h3>More to see along the route</h3>
<p>The castles are only part of the story. Towns, vineyards, Roman remains, river traffic, Romanticism and famous legends make the journey itself worth talking about.</p>
<button class="route-open-btn" id="openRouteFromInfo">🗺️ ON THE ROUTE →</button>
</div>
<div class="info-card">
<h3>The rebuild pattern</h3>
<p>Most castles here were first built in the 12th–14th centuries, destroyed by French troops (17th–18th c., especially under Louis XIV and later Napoleon), and rebuilt in the 19th century — often by the Prussian royal family, in the spirit of Rhine Romanticism.</p>
</div>
<div class="info-card">
<h3>Present-day life</h3>
<p>The valley's small towns live mainly on winegrowing (steep terraced Riesling vineyards, mostly hand-worked) and tourism (river cruises, hiking, castle visits). Populations here range from a few hundred to a few thousand — Bingen and Rüdesheim are the larger anchor towns at either end. A regional garden show (BUGA) is planned for 2029.</p>
</div>
<div class="info-card">
<h3>Ferries — everyday dependency</h3>
<p>There is no bridge across the Rhine anywhere in this stretch. Small car ferries connect the two banks. In very high water or very low water, ferries stop running — commuters and schoolchildren living on one side and working or studying on the other then face large detours, sometimes an hour or more, until the water level allows the ferry back.</p>
</div>
<div class="info-card">
<h3>Suggested narration order</h3>
<p>Leaving Koblenz: intro UNESCO + castle density → Stolzenfels/Lahneck: the destroy-and-rebuild pattern → Marksburg: the exception → Boppard bend: quiet scenic moment → St. Goar twins: toll/rivalry story → Loreley: legend, then the 1801 twist → Rheinstein/Reichenstein/Sooneck cluster → ferries: everyday-life story → Pfalzgrafenstein: visual punchline → Bacharach/Mäuseturm/Rüdesheim: arrival.</p>
</div>
</div>
